assertions: Installed CLI snapshot captures current unsaved clean SVG rather than source bytes; SHA256 matches exact exported bytes.
Selected and primary id-less layer keys, hierarchy, geometry, passive styles and local paint resources are bound to one live revision.
Hidden bounds are explicitly unsupported and manual locks are represented.
Capture does not mutate artwork, selection, history, dirty state or source files.
Producer independently checks the SVG digest and target instance/workspace binding. The server validates editor/session/revision challenge and response bindings.
Malformed, oversized, pending, stale, mismatched nonce, replaced editor and disconnected requests refuse without leaking snapshots; timeout and late replies are cleaned up.
Default context and error output do not include SVG, source path, credentials or internal traces.
limitations: Active/external SVG and CSS escapes or at-rules are explicitly refused.
